Check the bounded A5 AFD candidate without importing runtime packages. Reads
package metadata, source bytes and checkpoint headers only. No device,
operator library, tensor payload, installation or service is touched. A
passing report permits a candidate launch; it does not qualify full-model
execution.

checks.output:
usage: run_dsv41_a5_moe_parity.py [-h] --model MODEL
                                  --transformer-vendor TRANSFORMER_VENDOR
                                  --output-root OUTPUT_ROOT
                                  [--devices DEVICES] [--run]
                                  [--comparison {native-tp1-tp4,native-vs-afd}]
                                  [--setup-only]

Collect one bounded A5 single-layer MoE diagnostic archive. The default only
inspects checkpoint metadata and source files. --run explicitly loads one
layer in sequential native TP1/TP4 phases; --setup-only with --run checks
imports/configuration without loading weights or executing kernels.
--comparison native-vs-afd runs native TP4 and a constructor-free actual AFD
FFN-layer TP4 component instead, with same-weight compute controls. Complete
FFN construction, workers, runners and AFD transport are not exercised.

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --model MODEL
  --transformer-vendor TRANSFORMER_VENDOR
  --output-root OUTPUT_ROOT
  --devices DEVICES     process-visible NPU ordinals after
                        ASCEND_RT_VISIBLE_DEVICES remapping (default: 0,1,2,3)
  --run
  --comparison {native-tp1-tp4,native-vs-afd}
  --setup-only
